extName.description: Extension name. Not translated — it is the product name.

extDesc.message: Turn live chat and chat replay into a resizable side panel. Drag the divider to resize. Works in true fullscreen.
extDesc.description: Store and manifest description. Hard limit 132 characters.

optEnabledHint.message: Turn the panel off without uninstalling.
optEnabledHint.description: Popup: help text under the on/off switch.

optSwap.description: Popup: label for the switch that moves chat to the opposite side.

optSwapHint.description: Popup: help text under the side switch.

optDivider.description: Popup: label for the switch that shows or hides the drag divider.

optDividerHint.message: Hide it to keep the layout but stop resizing.
optDividerHint.description: Popup: help text under the divider switch.

optPageWidth.description: Popup: label for the chat width used in normal page view.

optFsWidth.description: Popup: label for the chat width used in fullscreen.

unitPx.description: Unit suffix for a pixel value. Usually left as px.

btnReset.description: Popup: button that restores every setting to its default.

toastSaved.description: Popup: brief confirmation shown after a setting changes.

noteNarrow.message: Below a 1000 px window YouTube stacks chat under the video, and the panel does not apply there.
noteNarrow.description: Popup: footnote explaining why nothing happens in a narrow window.

linkSource.description: Popup: link to the public source repository.

dividerTitle.message: Drag to resize chat · double-click to reset
dividerTitle.description: Tooltip on the drag divider in the page.

dividerAria.description: Screen-reader label for the drag divider.

flipAria.message: Move chat to the other side
flipAria.description: Screen-reader label and tooltip for the side-swap button.
